bullets.text: In Ponneri, contract worker Yukesh Kumar suffered a leg fracture at the Kattupalli desalination plant, prompting his family to stage a sit-in protest demanding proper compensation.
Residents in Gummidipoondi staged a sudden road blockade on the highway after enduring a four-hour midnight power cut, leveling serious complaints against electricity board officials.
Two persons were killed on the Maduravoyal Bypass Road near Vanagaram after a motorist lost control and crashed into a truck, and the office should monitor Avadi police updates.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Chennai for the metro inauguration, where Chief Minister Vijay welcomed him and rode together on the Poonamallee metro stretch.
During Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Chennai visit, Chief Minister Vijay appeared in black attire to welcome him, while political figures and statues drew public attention.
A backhoe loader suddenly caught fire and burned inside the Buckingham Canal in Chennai, and the constituency team should monitor safety and cleanup measures.
Police arrested a romantic couple, Aarti and Abinesh, for committing a theft at a doctor's house in Velachery and produced them in court to send them to prison.
Residents of Gandhi Nagar in Adyar stepped out of their homes over the weekend to assess neighborhood tree types and green cover damage.
Poovalan, a 38-year-old farmer from Thalavedu village near Tiruttani, died by suicide after battling a stomach problem for months while seeking treatment.
Gummidipoondi BDO office deployed 24 new garbage collection vehicles for 21 village panchayats funded by a private firm's corporate social responsibility scheme worth 48 lakh rupees.
Bengaluru is planning a massive 70-acre AI city, raising concerns about whether Chennai will lag behind in attracting similar artificial intelligence infrastructure investments.
Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran released a private white paper on AI, automation, and India's workforce to guide future employment and economic policies.
Suzlon announced a 550 crore rupee investment in three AI-powered wind blade factories across Gujarat, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu, creating 15000 jobs by 2027.
May 17 Movement members staged a black flag protest in Chennai against Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit, leading to arrests and house arrests of Congress leaders.
Contractors reported that ruling party affiliates demanded a 50 lakh rupee bribe to extract gravel soil, causing a halt to quarry and lake extraction works.
Over 100 students and youth activists in Chennai were detained following scuffles and protests demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 4900 crore rupee 15-kilometre Chennai Metro Phase II stretch from Poonamallee alongside Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay urged the Centre to grant early approval for Chennai Metro Phase III and release 5110 crore rupees in education funds.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in Chennai to launch 13000 crore rupees worth of development projects, and the office should track ongoing infrastructure rollouts.
